2. **Captan 50% WP** — Apply 2 g per liter of water at 7–10 day intervals

## Organic Treatment
- **Sulfur fungicide** — Apply 3 g per liter every 7 days; avoid spraying in temperatures above 30°C
- **Neem oil spray** — 5 ml per liter of water, spray every 10 days

## Recommended Fertilizers

4. **Calcium-based foliar spray** — Strengthens cell walls; apply post-flowering

- Prune trees to improve air circulation
- Spray fungicide before rain events during spring
